text: Makar Sankranti / Pongal falls on 2024-01-14, primarily observed in the South region. Harvest festival; strong regional gifting and food-category demand lift.

Christmas falls on 2024-12-25, primarily observed in the East region. Strong gifting and retail demand, pronounced in East and South urban markets.
New Year's Eve falls on 2024-12-31, primarily observed in the West region. Year-end retail and hospitality demand spike.
